remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)

# ucx01000.sys is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ucx01000-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(ucx01000_shims OBJECT classlib.cpp driver.cpp exports.cpp)
target_link_libraries(ucx01000_shims PRIVATE ntoskrnl_vista libcntpr libwdfldr libntoskrnl libhal wdfdriverentry)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" OR CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
    target_compile_options(ucx01000_shims PRIVATE -Wno-write-strings)
endif()
target_compile_definitions(ucx01000_shims PRIVATE
    WDF_DEVICE_NO_WDMSEC_H _WIN32_WINNT=0x603 NTDDI_VERSION=0x06030000)
target_include_directories(ucx01000_shims PRIVATE
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/ucx/1.6
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/wdf/shared/inc/private/common
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/wdf/kmdf/inc/private
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/lib/drivers/wdf_reactos/include)
add_cargo_module(ucx01000 ucx01000-cargo ucx01000.sys
    KIND kmdfdriver
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    NO_CAB
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ucx01000_shims psdk asm)
